title: viscum quadrangulare
intro: Viscum quadrangulare, commonly known as European mistletoe, is a hemiparasitic plant that grows on the branches of various tree species. European mistletoe is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce cancer risk, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Viscum quadrangulare include its potential to inhibit cancer cell growth, modulate the immune response, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lectins, viscotoxins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
